publisher: International Facility Management Association (reported by FMLink); BOMA International (reported by Building Design+Construction)
vintage: IFMA Operations and Maintenance Benchmarks, spring and summer 2000; BOMA Experience Exchange Report, 2012 data
table: Median janitorial and total operating cost per square foot (IFMA); average total operating expenses and the change in cleaning spending per square foot (BOMA)
title: Cleaning as a share of an office building's operating cost
universe: IFMA North American professional members' facilities; BOMA U.S. office properties (cleaning figure: private-sector office buildings)
limits: Both are office-building benchmarks, not public-building spending; neither publisher's full report is public. IFMA's operating cost is janitorial plus utility plus maintenance medians; BOMA's total operating expenses also include security, roads and grounds and administration, closer to the Census current-operations scope. The BOMA cleaning level is derived from a rounded change ($0.06, 4.0 percent), so it carries rounding error of about plus or minus 10 percent.
